Vector-database server with direct decorated tool definitions, providing a high-value production-style Python history target.
Vendor-maintained database server. The AST extractor recognizes attribute decorators such as @self.mcp.tool without executing server initialization.

Direct decorated tools are statically mineable. Dynamic ToolAnnotations constructor values may be omitted by the conservative extractor while names, descriptions and function signatures remain recoverable.

repositories.registration_pattern: @mcp.tool decorators with module constants and helper-built descriptions
repositories.notes: The static binding resolver recovers literal module-level tool names such as NAME. Helper-built descriptions and annotations remain intentionally partial and must be reported as extraction coverage limits.
